claims.quote: Hemibagrus peguensis is a bagrid catfish from the Irrawaddy, Bago and Sittaung drainages of Myanmar and the Chindwin basin in northeastern India.
Hemibagrus peguensis is a bagrid catfish from the Irrawaddy, Bago and Sittaung drainages of Myanmar and the Chindwin basin in northeastern India.
Occurs throughout much of Myanmar in the Irrawaddy (aka Ayeyarwady), Bago and Sittaung (aka Sittang) river drainages plus the Chindwin basin, Manipur state, northeastern India.
